open_points.subject: liveness and readiness HTTP operations
open_points.text: Liveness answers `ok` without reading anything. Readiness opens one `module:portal_store` transaction and rolls it back; it changes no product state.
open_points.question: Which HTTP method and path invoke each health check, and which named `module:runtime` capability handles each request?
options: GET `/live` and GET `/ready`, delegated to separate runtime capabilities
Another explicit route and capability mapping
open_points.default_guess: Use GET `/health/live` and GET `/health/ready`, with handlers created inside `runtime.create_runtime_app`.

witness.initial: Valid runtime configuration; the runtime application has been created and is ready to be served.
events: The deployment process starts the application.
A monitor sends GET `/health/live` on a trusted host.
outcomes: An implementer registers `/health/live`; the monitor receives `HealthStatus` `ok`.
An implementer chooses `/live` because no route is specified; the monitor receives 404 at `/health/live` even though liveness is available elsewhere.
